comparison.objective: Slide a magnetic finder flat on a wall until it locks to a hidden screw; candidate registers and fastens switches.
comparison.physical_skill: Surface-following search and passive magnetic capture versus controlled fastener release, precision mount sliding, sensing, and retightening.
comparison.success_condition: Finder flat with magnet within 10 mm of a screw, released and hanging still 1 s; candidate needs two ≤6 mm over-center registrations held 3 s.
comparison.reason: Both use proximity-mediated registration, but the record tests search and magnetic retention, not adjustable mount calibration. Candidate indicator hysteresis, fastener torque, and drift tolerance remain unspecified.
